/de bzhin du spyi bo pu li ra ma la yar pu las myur zhing rab tu dpa' mo sku mdog dmar mo zhag gcig phyag brgyad ma dang po gnyis rab tu dga' ba'i phyag rgya bcas shing*/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis mda' gzhu dang*/ g.yas kyi lhag ma gnyis dkyil 'khor 'khor lo dang*/ ral gri| g.yon gnyis kyis dung dang*/ zhags pa bsnams pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /spyi gtsug dz+wa lan+dha rar dza las ston ka'i zla ba dkar mo zhal gsum phyag bcu gnyis ma/ zhal g.yas sngo/ g.yon ser zhing*/ phyag dang po gnyis kyi mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya dang lhag ma'i g.yas rnams kyi kha ṭ+waṃ ga/'khor lo/ rin po che/ rdo rje/ me tog gi phreng ba/ g.yon rnams kyis ril ba spyi blugs| ud pa la/ dril bu/ bum pa/ po ti bsnams so/ /rna ba g.yas pa u rgyan du u las gser gyi mdog can ma ser mo zhal gcig phyag bcu ma phyag g.yas rnams na phreng ba/ ral gri/ mda'/ rdo rje/ dbyug pa/ g.yon rnams na dar dpyangs/ zhags pa/ pad ma/ dril bu/ gzhu bsnams pa'o/ /ltag pa arbu ta ra a las gtsug tor rnam rgyal ma ser mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ phyag g.yas gnyis kyis mchog sbyin dang*/ phreng ba/ g.yon gnyis kyis ril ba spyi blugs dang*/ dbyug gu bsnam pa'o/ /rna ba g.yon pa go ta wa rīr go las hūm̐ rab tu sgrogs ma ser mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas skyabs sbyin dang*/ g.yon pad+ma ser po bsnams pa'o/ /smin ma'i dbus ra mi shwa rir ra las sgrol ma sku'i dbang phyug ma/ dkar mo zhal gsum phyag drug ma zhal g.yas gnag/g.yon dmar ba/ phyag g.yas gsum na 'khor lo pad+ma/ rdo rje/ g.yon gsum na/ ral gri/ dri bu/ nor bu bsnams pa'o/ /mig gnyis de bi ko ṭir de las 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ma dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas gnyis na rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis sdig mdzub dang zhags pa bsnams pa'o| |phrag pa gnyis ma la war ma las gzhan 'joms ma khro mo nag mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/

g.yas gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang*/ ral gri/ g.yon gnyis kyis skye gnas kyi steng du zhags pa 'dzin pa dang*/ sdig mdzub mdzad pa'o| |mchan khung gnyis ka ma ru par ka las bdud thams cad 'joms shing dbang mchog ster ma ser mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi mchu srin steng skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa g.yas na mya ngan med pa'i shing dang rin po che/ g.yon pad ma dang bum pa bsnams pa'o/ /nu ma o trir a las 'dod pa thams cad rab tu sbyin ma bzhengs pa mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ dang po gnyis kyis thugs khar rab tu dga' ba'i phyag rgya dang*/ g.yas kyis gnyis pas gar byed pa'i tshul dang*/ g.yon gyi gnyis pas mya ngan med pa'i shing bsnams pa'o// lte ba tri sha ku nir tri las mya ngan thams cad sel bar byed ma dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis spyi bor rab tu dga' ba'i phyag rgya mdzad cing*/ g.yas kyis gnyis pas ral gri dang*/ g.yon gyi gnyis pas mya ngan med pa'i shing bsnams pa'o/ /sna rtse ko sa lar ko las 'gro ba thams cad 'gugs shing 'phongs pa thams cad sel bar mdzad ma/ khro mo mun pa'i mdog can zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas pa lcags kyus gza' brgyad dgugs shing*| g.yon pas zhags pa bsnams pa'o/ kha ka ling kar ka las bkra shis thams cad sbyin ma ser mo zhal gcig phyag brgyad ma g.yas rnams na rtse gsum/ lcags kyu/ rdo rje/ ral gri/ g.yon rnams na/ rin po che/ zhags pa/ dbyug gu bum pa bsnams pa'o/ /mgrin pa lam pa kar lam las sgrol ma gsung gi dbang phyug ma dmar mo zhal gsum phyag drug ma g.yas dkar g.yon gnag pa/ phyag g.yas na pad+ma/ rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ g.yon na nor bu/ dril bu/ ral gri/ bsnams pa'o/ /snying kha kan tsi ka las sgrol ma thugs kyis dbang phyug nag mo zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ zhal g.yas dmar g.yon dkar ba/ phyag g.yas rdo rje| 'khor lo/ pad+m/ g.yon na dril bu/ ral gri/ nor bu bsnams pa'o/

/ mdom par hi ma la yar hi las yongs su smin par byed ma khro mo dmar mo/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas na ral gri dang*/ mda'/ g.yon na 'khor lo dang gzhu bsnams pa'o/ /rtags kyi rtse pre ta pu rir pre las 'gugs par byed pa'i khro mo nag mo zhal gsum phyag drug ma g.yas dkar g.yon dmar ba/ phyag g.yas rnams na/ ral gri/ lcags kyu/ dbyug gu/ g.yon rnams na thod pa/ zhags pa/ 'khor lo bsnams pa'o/ /bshang lam gri ha de bar gri las zhi ba chen mo dkar mo zhal gcig phyag drug ma phyag g.yas rnams na/ phreng ba/ mchog sbyin| dbyug gu/ g.yon na pad+ma ril ba spyi blugs/ po ti bsnams pa'o/ /brla sau raṣ+tar sau las chags pa 'joms ma dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas pas rtse gsum dang*/ g.yon pas ud pa la dang bcas pa'iphyag rgya rked par 'jog pa'o/ /byin pa su warna dī par su las bde ba thams cad bsgrub ma dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phyag gnyis kyi thugs kar/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsnams pa'o/ /rkang lag gi sor mo bcu drug na ga rar na las rnam par rgyal ma ngang pa'i steng du sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ dang po gnyis kyis rab tu dga' ba'i phyag rgya mdzad cing*/ g.yas kyi gnyis pas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa rdo rje khu tshur dkur 'jog pa'o/ /bol gong sin+dhur si las sdug bsngal thams cad sreg ma dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phyag gnyis kyis thugs khar me thab bsnams pa'o/ /mthe bo ma ror ma las dngos grub thams cad 'byung ma dmar ser/ zhal gcig ma phyag gnyis kyis gser gyi bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa'o/ /pus mo ku lu tar/ ku las yongs su rdzogs par byed ma dkar mo khyu mchog la gnas pa'i khro mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas pa bgrang phreng dang*/ g.yon pa rtse gsum bsnams pa'o/ /de ltar lha thams cad kyang snang la rang bzhin med pa me long gi gzugs brnyan ltar gsal btab la/

slar yang de dag dang rjes su mtshungs pa'i ye shes pa spyan drangs la bstims/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs nas/ sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis dbang gi lha 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs pa la mchod pa rnams kyis mchod nas gsol ba btab pas/ dbang bskur nas phyi nang gi gtso mo la don yod grub pa dang*/ gzhan thugs kyi lha rnams la mi bskyod pa dang*/ gsung gi lha rnams la 'od dpag tu med pa dang*/ sku'i lha rnams la rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan par bsam mo/ /de dag la phyi dang nang dang yid las byung ba'i mchod pas mchod nas/ phyag 'tshal nyi shu rtsa gcig pas bstod nas/ spyi dang so so'i rnam pa la rim pa bzhin yid bzung bar bya'o/ /de nas bsgom par 'dod na/ man ngag las 'byung ba bzhin/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa'ang bsgom par bya ste/ man ngag ni gzhan dang thun mong ba nyid do/ /de ltar mnyam par bzhag pa las langs nas/ gang la spro bar gyur pa'i sngags kyis bzlas pa'ang*/ ji srid skyo bar ma gyur gyi bar de srid du bzlas par bya'o/ /gtor ma la sogs pa'i yan lag gzhan ni gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom pa'i man ngag gi rim pa grub pa brnyes pa'i kha che'i slob dpon nyi ma sbas pa'i zhabs las brgyud pa'i man ngag 'phags pas sbyar ba'o/ /dge'o//
